parameters.content:
## Appointment Reminder System
Reminders at 48 hours and 2 hours, one-tap confirm or reschedule, and freed slots offered to the waitlist.

Runs hourly over your bookings sheet. Add a formula column `hours_until` (appointment time minus now) and columns for the patient's latest reply and which reminders were sent. Sends the 48h and 2h reminders, offers cancelled slots to the next person on the waitlist, and flags unconfirmed bookings within 24 hours for a phone call.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/appointment-reminder-system
